messages:
erin: following the postmortem, we need to finalize customer comms and the RCA sharing approach. three things: status page line, a 72h public customer brief, and policy for sharing full RCAs vs redacted briefs.

violet: I can draft the statuspage sentence. Suggest: "Elevated latency impacting Text Generation API between 02:2202:47 UTC during a model rollout. Rollback and throttling applied; no customer data exposure detected. Full postmortem forthcoming after review."

sam: prefer 'no customer data exposure' only after sec confirms. Add a one-line mitigation: "Mitigation: rollback + temporary throttling."

lee: I will draft the 72h brief (TL;DR, timeline, impact numbers, top FAQs). Need a clear list of what legal wants redacted for public copy.

legal: Legal POV: public summary should be high level. redact orchestration commands, internal hostnames, and step-by-step playbooks. Full RCA can be provided to affected enterprise customers under NDA/DPA. Post your redaction list here and we'll sign off.

sec-bot: Security scan complete: no exfiltration found. Sec signs off on the "no customer data exposure" line.

ops: ProdOps can push status page once the line is posted to #statuspage-drafts and legal/sec sign off.

eng-runtime: Noted recurring pattern with KV eviction during rollouts. We'll create ticket RUNTIME-3222 to add rollout guards; target next sprint.

sales: I'll prepare the affected-account export for enterprise outreach once Lee posts the impacted list.

erin: action list and owners (please react when complete):
- Violet: post final statuspage sentence to #statuspage-drafts and tag ProdOps (due 2468013600)
- Lee: draft 72h brief with TL;DR, timeline, metrics, FAQs and post here for review (due 2468013620)
- Legal: publish redaction checklist (due 2468013615)
- Eng-runtime: open guardrail ticket RUNTIME-3222 (due 2468013625)
- Sales: prepare affected-account list after Lee posts (due 2468013625)

violet: will post statuspage draft in a min.

lee: drafting now, will include top 4 FAQs: "Was my data affected?", "What caused it?", "How is this fixed?", "What are you doing to prevent recurrence?"

legal: will review redaction list within 24h after Lee posts.

eng-runtime: RUNTIME-3222 created, priority P1, ETA 2 sprints.

erin: thanks everyone. once legal/sec approve we'll publish the public note and send targeted briefs to affected customers. react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. closing thread unless blockers appear.
